in_marathi.name: Naru
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Naru is a Sanskrit name derived from the term Narayana, which refers to Lord Vishnu in his resting form. The name is a compound of 'Nara' (man) and 'Ayana' (rest), symbolizing the divine power that rests in all beings. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer strength, wisdom, and divine protection.
